questions: Ruby could walk and talk right away, but she still needed help. What do you like getting help with?
Why did Ruby put down the crown to catch the egg? What would you have wanted to save?
Pearl could choose whether to stay. How can you show a friend you care without making their choices for them?
Ruby made a mistake with her fire, then tried something different. Can you remember a time you changed your plan?
lookAndFind: Find Ruby's silver dragon mark, Flame's yellow tummy, and Pearl's clear bubbles. Which picture has a crown beside warm bread?

spreads.title: Zero, exactly
spreads.text:
In the kingdom of Riverlight, under a bell,
a girl said hello from inside an eggshell.

Out stepped Ruby. Rainbow hair. Golden eyes.
A silver dragon mark, small as a sigh.
She could walk. She could talk. She could ask for some bread.
"How old?" asked the cook.
"Zero," she said.
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Ruby newly stepping out of a large split pearly egg onto a soft cushion in a sunlit palace nursery, fully dressed in her normal plum tunic and boots, tiny crown already on her head; decorative brass bell overhead, bread roll on a low table. Ruby is a human child, not a dragon hatchling. Cook is off-frame, no other people or dragons.

vocab.definition: a land with a king, queen, or princess

spreads.title: A princess, and a beginner
spreads.text:
The silver mark meant she would lead Riverlight.
The crown fit her head. The big chair wasn't right.
Her feet couldn't reach. There was much she didn't know.

The king, her papa, said, "We can learn slow.
I'll help, and the gardeners and cooks will help too.
You don't have to know everything to be you."
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Ruby sitting sideways on an oversized cushioned gold and lavender throne, boots dangling far above floor, looking thoughtfully at a small sapling in a pot beside the chair. Warm sunlight, inviting open doors. Her father is speaking off-frame; no other people, no dragons. Normal plum dress.

vocab.definition: to help people find a way forward

spreads.title: Flame
spreads.text:
Her dragon was Flame: red, orange, and yellow,
a snuggly, bouncy, tumble-down fellow.
A girl, to be clear. A baby, quite small.
She chased her own tail and fell over it all.

When Ruby felt wobbly, Flame tucked herself near.
No crown was required. Just a lap. Just here.
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Ruby sitting cross-legged on a garden rug laughing as Flame rolls playfully onto her back beside Ruby's lap, showing yellow belly and curled tail. Close cozy scene, tiny crown rests on rug, sunlight through willow leaves, no other characters. Ruby normal plum dress.

vocab.definition: soft and cozy to cuddle close

spreads.title: The first bond
spreads.text:
Flame pressed her nose to an outstretched hand.
A warm little feeling said: I understand.
Ruby's dress shimmered like embers at night;
a curl of soft fire made her fingertips bright.

Still a girl. Still Ruby. With something to share.
Their bond was a promise: I'll answer. I'll care.
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Ruby and Flame touching nose to open palm in a garden in afternoon sunlight. Ruby remains entirely human but her tunic dress has transformed to ember red with golden trim, tiny controlled warm curl of fire over her free hand, silver dragon forehead mark glowing. No wings or horns or tail on Ruby. Tender mutual bond, no other characters.

vocab.definition: a special closeness between friends who care
little glowing bits left in a warm fire

spreads.title: A chair they wanted
spreads.text:
But Noir, her stepmother, wanted that chair.
And War, her stepsister, said, "It isn't fair!
I've waited for years. She hatched just today!"

"Then we'll take her place," Noir said. "Our way."
Their dragon, Black Hole, gave a mean little grin.
He liked making things disappear into him.
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Noir, War and Black Hole in a palace side room, Noir pointing toward a distant empty throne through an arch, War arms crossed stomping one foot, Black Hole smugly watching a tiny purple-edged dark swirl near his snout. Lavender window light and several warm lamps keep everyone fully visible. No Ruby, no other dragons or people.

vocab.definition: to go where you cannot see something anymore

spreads.title: Attack practice
spreads.text:
"Attack!" called War. A little black round
swallowed a cushion without any sound.
"Again!" ordered Noir. In went a chair.
Black Hole laughed purple sparks into the air.

The stolen things stayed in his pocket of night.
When he sneezed, they popped out.
War said, "Hold it tight!"

War points at a soft lavender cushion being gently sucked toward a small purple-rimmed black circular magical pocket above Black Hole's nose. A little wooden chair already protrudes from the swirl. Black Hole gleeful and smug; Noir approving. Bright daylight, comic action, no injuries, no other characters.

vocab.definition: a soft pillow you can sit on

spreads.title: The locked egg
spreads.text:
They'd stolen an egg from the waterfall nest:
white, blue, and trembling inside an iron chest.
"A water dragon," said Noir. "One more power to keep."

Ruby heard tapping when she should have been napping.
She followed with Flame to the chest by the wall.
Something inside it was frightened and small.
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Ruby and Flame discovering an open-lidded iron chest with a locked iron lattice across the opening, inside one white egg streaked sky blue on a folded cloth. Ruby reaches toward the lattice, concerned. Warm lantern illuminates faces and egg clearly in palace storage alcove; afternoon sunlight through window. Normal plum dress. No villains visible.

spreads.title: Too much fire
spreads.text:
"I'll melt the lock!" Ruby's fire flared wide.
The egg gave a frightened little knock inside.

Ruby stopped. Her cheeks burned hot.
Being able to do it didn't mean that she ought.
"Smaller," she whispered. Flame warmed just the pin.
Click went the lock. Cool air drifted in.
spreads.imagePrompt: Exactly Ruby and Flame at iron chest, protective iron lattice now opening. Ruby's ember-red transformed tunic, hands lowered with her fire extinguished, thoughtful concerned expression. Flame uses a tiny precise candle-sized flame on the outer lock pin far from egg. White and blue egg safely nested in chest behind lattice, clearly unharmed. Warm well-lit scene, no other characters.

spreads.title: Put something down
spreads.text:
They reached the bridge. "Attack!" shouted War.
Black Hole's dark circle pulled harder than before.
Ruby's crown slipped. The egg rocked near the side.
She couldn't catch both, though she very much tried.

Down went the crown with a plink in the stream.
Two hands caught the egg.
"I've got you," said she.

No Noir, no other people, no one falling, safe expressive drama.

spreads.title: Pearl chooses
spreads.text:
Under the willow, the shell split in two.
Out tumbled white paws and a nose colored blue.
Clear bubbles bobbed round the little one's head.
"Pearl? Would that suit you?" the princess said.

Pearl nodded. Ruby left room by the stream.
"You can stay. You can go. You can choose what you need."
Pearl took one small step. Then she leaned against Flame.

spreads.title: Water hands
spreads.text:
Pearl touched Ruby's palm. A cool sparkle grew.
Her dress rippled white, then waterfall blue.
Still a girl, with two feet planted firm on the land,
Ruby lifted a bubble with each of her hands.

Flame's glow was still there, like a lamp down the hall.
A new friend didn't mean less love. Not at all.

spreads.title: The thing she could refuse
spreads.text:
Noir blocked the path. "That dragon is mine.
I found her. I kept her. Get back in line."

"You kept her locked up," Ruby said, standing near.
"She isn't a prize. And she isn't staying here."

Her voice shook a little. Her feet didn't go.
Even a very new girl could say no.

spreads.title: A different plan
spreads.text:
Black Hole attacked with a greedy black swirl.
Flame puffed back fire. "Wait!" shouted the girl.
The circle gulped flame and grew wider still.

Ruby stepped back. Then she stood very still.
She'd seen him sneeze cushions. A tickle might do.
"Pearl, blow some bubbles. Flame, warm them through!"

spreads.title: The enormous achoo
spreads.text:
Ruby's water hands lifted. Flame breathed soft heat.
Warm bubbles went bobbling, a whole wobbly fleet.
They burst by his nostrils. One. Two.
Black Hole scrunched up his snout.
"AHHHHH-CHOO!"

Out flew the cushion! The chair! War's left shoe!
The circle snapped shut.
Black Hole sneezed anew.

Bright golden daylight, transparent bubbles, slapstick safe, no additional people or dragons.

vocab.definition: a group of boats, or bubbles pretending to be boats

spreads.title: A gate, not a goodbye
spreads.text:
At Ruby's call, her papa came. The gardeners came too.
Noir backed off with Black Hole. War hopped on one shoe.
"This isn't finished!" she called through the gate.
"It is for tonight," Ruby said. "You can wait."

The grown-ups kept watch. Ruby let herself lean.
She didn't have to be everyone's shield to be queen.
Not queen yet, of course. There was growing to do.

Two warm adult-sized guardian shadows cast from OFF FRAME across gate show adults keeping watch, no additional visible people. Sunset reassurance, no menace.

vocab.definition: something that helps keep you safe from harm

spreads.title: Room for two
spreads.text:
They found her crown in a puddle downstream.
Ruby washed it, then left it beside her to gleam.
She asked for warm bread and a blanket for three.
Flame curled by her elbow. Pearl slept by her knee.

"Zero," she murmured. "And what a first day."
Her hands opened softly. Her friends chose to stay.

Far off, beyond Riverlight, thunder rolled low.
But tonight there was nowhere that Ruby must go.
